source_observations.input_audio: PCM audio; upstream benchmark/source uses 16 kHz and up to 8 seconds of current-turn audio
source_observations.runtime_form: local ONNX inference; CPU artifact is int8 quantized
source_observations.intended_composition: lightweight VAD detects a pause; Smart Turn classifies whether the user is actually done; classify again if speech resumes
source_observations.architecture_summary: Whisper-Tiny-class audio encoder features plus a binary end-of-turn classifier; upstream describes approximately 8M parameters
source_observations.upstream_latency_claim: as little as ~10 ms on some CPUs and under 100 ms on most cloud instances; not reproduced on Frankenstein hardware

security_dependency_notes.preferred_artifact: ONNX model rather than arbitrary remote model code
security_dependency_notes.training_source_observation: current source includes optional W&B/training machinery and Modal-related training paths; these are not required to treat the pinned ONNX inference artifact as the candidate runtime subject
security_dependency_notes.f2_requirement: production integration should pin the ONNX bytes and minimal auditable local inference path; no training/telemetry/remote inference dependency should enter LOCAL-SOLO acceptance

hypothesis: Smart Turn v3.2 is a stronger direct German production candidate for semantic end-of-turn classification than the generation-1 SoulX-Duplug source candidate because upstream explicitly includes German and provides a small local ONNX artifact with German benchmark results.
counterhypotheses: Upstream German benchmark quality may not transfer to the user's microphone, accent, room noise, echo, pauses, self-interruptions or Frankenstein conversational timing.
A pause-triggered end-of-turn classifier may reduce false endpoints yet add enough decision latency to hurt perceived responsiveness.
The model does not by itself solve true full-duplex overlap, backchannels, playback truncation or cancellation of unheard output.
A deterministic silence/VAD controller tuned to the actual user may match or beat Smart Turn on the real F2 distribution at lower complexity.

f2_architecture_delta.candidate_role: semantic EOT gate downstream of VAD pause and upstream of VoiceIntent/GWT response commitment
f2_architecture_delta.recommended_measurement: On clay-direct-dev, compare Smart Turn v3.2 CPU against the admitted current endpoint controller using pinned German room-audio turns. Measure false-cut/false-wait rates, pause-to-EOT decision p50/p95/p99, user-end-to-first-audio delta, CPU/RSS, and interaction with barge-in/cancellation.
